description: Hackathon Agent Kit session lifecycle hooks: context injection, session event capture and learning handoff. Every hook is best-effort: failures are logged to stderr and the hook exits 0, so a hook never blocks a session. On Windows Codex runs command hooks through cmd.exe, which does not expand POSIX $PLUGIN_ROOT; commandWindows uses the cmd-native %PLUGIN_ROOT% form without quotes (Codex re-escapes quotes in hook commands on Windows).
